findings.value: A shop under the arches in London Fields that sells British ciders and perries and runs bookable tastings on Friday and Saturday evenings.

evidence.quote: We specialise mainly in fine British ciders
the Fine Cider Company specialises in British ciders and perries sourced from all over the country
it's under the arches, close to e5 Bakehouse
there are tastings held every Friday and Saturday where you can try over half a dozen styles

notes: London On The Inside (press, published 3 June 2026, updated 23 June 2026) reviews the shop; the ticket page is the venue's own. It is a cider shop with tastings, not a bar or a music venue, so the editor should decide whether it fits the guide. One WebSearch found no other press.
